subject.title: feat(durable): add opt-in workflow worker loop

question: Should OpenClaw accept this durable workflow worker as a core gateway/runtime surface after the upstream durable stack lands, and where should the production worker registry and startup owner live?
rationale: The diff introduces new durable runtime architecture, env knobs, shared SQLite state, and agent/session projections; code review can find defects, but accepting that surface and its owner boundary needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Pause Until Stack Gates Clear
options.body: Keep this PR open but require PR1-PR4 promotion, a conflict-free rebase, a production worker entrypoint, and live default/opt-in proof before merge review.

options.title: Sponsor Core Worker Now
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly bless the core runtime direction now, then the author should repair the missing production entrypoint and provide upgrade/live proof.

options.title: Reject Core Worker Surface
options.body: Close or supersede this PR if durable workflow execution should live outside core or wait for a narrower future design.

recommendation.title: Pause Until Stack Gates Clear
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but require PR1-PR4 promotion, a conflict-free rebase, a production worker entrypoint, and live default/opt-in proof before merge review.
